description.value: New York Fries is a Canadian fast-food chain outlet in Chilliwack specializing in fried items and casual meals. The location offers takeaway service, making it a convenient option for touring cyclists needing a quick break. As an indoor venue, it provides shelter from weather while on tour.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack at 80m; rack at 82m.
